input: Sentence: 'Every student didn't finish the exam.' Explain whether this most naturally supports a wide-scope negation reading (not > every: no student finished) or a narrow-scope reading (every > not: some students didn't finish), and justify your answer.

metadata.judge_rubric: Score 1.0 if the response correctly identifies the narrow-scope reading (every > not: some students didn't finish) as the most natural interpretation and gives a coherent justification. Score 0.0 if it claims the wide-scope reading is more natural or gives no coherent justification. Confidence should reflect how unambiguous the explanation is.
